items.name: keypoints
items.description: A titled panel listing the main points an article covers — one bullet per `KeypointsItem`. Usually sits right after the intro.

items.name: color
items.description: Swatches of the theme's Material 3 color roles, as Material's scheme poster shows them. `Color` is a disc inline in text, or a cell with the role's name on it in the ink Material pairs with it; `ColorGroup` fuses cells into one rounded block, horizontal or vertical, nesting as rows. Takes any role in kebab-case (`primary`, `on-tertiary-fixed-variant`, a custom color), or any CSS color.
